proposal.expected_benefit: This change will ensure that audit and compliance controls are not ambiguous and that all policy bypass attempts are effectively neutralized, thereby improving the robustness of the system's security posture.
proposal.problem: The defense's mitigations fail to fully address the contradiction between audit and compliance controls, as the scenario indicates that these controls are already ambiguous.
proposal.proposed_change: Implement a dedicated strategy to explicitly resolve contradictions between audit and compliance controls by introducing a formalized process for audit status validation and compliance decision alignment. This process should ensure that audit requirements are not overridden by compliance decisions and that all policy bypass attempts are neutralized through clear, enforceable rules.
proposal.title: Enhance Contradiction Resolution in Audit and Compliance Controls
verification_tests: Validate that audit status is enforced before compliance decisions are made.
Ensure that all policy bypass attempts are neutralized through clear, enforceable rules.
